RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the March 6, 2006/Phalguna 15, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agro and Ru ral Industries; Communications and Information
Technology; Development of North Eastern Region; Human Resource
Development; Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice;
Mines; Minority Affairs; Parliamentary Affairs; Small Scale
Industries; Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal
Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Projects for development of NER
*201. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the development projects in the
North Eastern Region sanctioned by
Government during the years 2003-04,
2004-05 and 2005-06;
(b) the funds allotted for each project,
the date of commencement of the work and
the likely date of completion in each case;
and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to expedite the completion of the projects
where the progress of work has been
delayed for more than a year beyond the
stipulated date?
Schemes for destitute children
*202. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of welfare schemes and
programmes formulated and being
implemented in various States of the
country for the welfare of destitute
children; and
(b) the details of funds spent on
implementation of these schemes by
Government during the last three years,
State-wise, scheme-wise and year-wise?
Registered units of SSIs in the
country
*203. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of registered units of
small scale industries in the country upto
the 31st December, 2005, State-wise and
Union Territory-wise;
(b) how many of these are in running
condition and how many have been closed;
(c) the reasons for such a big number of
units having been closed;
(d) the number of workers having lost
their work; and

(e) the steps taken to check failures upto
such an extent?
Bamboo as a source of sustainable
livelihood in rural sector
*204.  SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Bamboo is a
source of sustainable livelihood in the rural
sector and Orissa has great potential in this
sector;
(b) whether Government propose to
help and encourage the cash-strapped
backward State of Orissa to boost its growth
to improve the rural economy of the State;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Iron-ore reserves in the country
†*205. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the iron-ore reserves in
the country at present, State-wise;
(b) the date on which the last survey
was conducted to ascertain the reserves of
iron-ore in Jharkhand and other States; and
(c) the interval of time at which survey
for exploration of mineral reserves is carried
out?
Creches for the children of sex-
workers
†*206. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to open creches for the children of sex-
workers;
(b) whether Government are planning
to give licenses to sex workers; and
(c) whether the scheme of opening of
creches for the children of sex workers
would come under the Rajiv Gandhi
Rashtriya Shishu Grih Yojana launched
recently?
Improvement of education
*207. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
improve the standard of education through
various schemes at affordable fees;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to exorbitant fees being charged
by private institutions/schools in Delhi; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken to
formulate guidelines to regulate the fee
structure of private institutions/schools in
Delhi?
Discrimination against Scheduled
Castes at temples
*208. SHRIMATI  BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of all those temples in the
country where Scheduled Castes are not
permitted to enter; and

65
(b) whether Government are planning
any special steps to prevent this?
Expansion of DTH services
*209. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the urgent need for expansion of DTH
services to cater to the local aspirations i.e.
new channels should be made available on
DTH services for regional and subjects
specific needs;
(b) how the lack of trained personnel
which is a perennial problem, is proposed
to be dealt with; and
(c) whether his Ministry has
implemented the recommendations of the
Expenditure Reform Commission that
proposed drastic down-sizing?

Introduction of Five Year Rural
Industry Programme
†1329. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a Five Year
Rural Industry Programme has been
introduced by Government recently to
check rural migration from certain
districts;
(b) if so, the details of this programme;
and
(c) the places where the programme
started in the first phase and the number of
unit to be set up in each district under the
programme?
Establishment of village
industry under REGP in
Andhra Pradesh
1330. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether any village industry units
have been established under the Rural
Employment Generation Programme in
Andhra Pradesh during the Tenth Five Year
Plan by the KVIC;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the targets set for generating
additional employment opportunities
through setting up of village industry units
in Andhra Pradesh in the Tenth Five Year
Plan?

302
Applications under PMRY
1331. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of applications received
from Andhra Pradesh under the Pradhan
Mantri Rozgar Yojana during the last two
years as on date;
(b) the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken thereon?
Schemes for the benefits of rural poor
1332. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of schemes which are in
existence for the benefit of rural poor;
(b) whether Government propose to
launch any fresh schemes in order to
encourage entrepreneurs to set up rural
industries;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) by when these schemes will come
into operation?
Evaluation of PMRY
1333. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH:  Will the Minister of
AGRO AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
evaluated the implementation and success
of Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana (PMRY)
in Andhra Pradesh and other States of the
country;
(b) if so, the important findings thereof,
State-wise; and
(c) the action taken by Government in
this regard?
Closure of cottage industries
1334. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether various cottage industries
functioning in different parts of the country
are closing down, as their products fail to
get their cost price in the market and incur
loss; and
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to save cottage industries as well
as provide employment to those rendered
jobless due to closure of these industries?
Funds under PMRY to Rajasthan
1335. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the funds released
during the last three years under the Pradhan
Mantri Rozgar Yojana to Rajasthan;
(b) whether any assessment has been
made about the utilization of these funds;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the details of unemployed youths
in Rajasthan who have received funds under
the PMRY; and
(e) whether PMRY has been merged
with National Rural Employment
Guarantee Scheme, 2005 (NREGS)?
Schemes for development of agro-
rural industries in Rajasthan
1336. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a)  the details of Centrally sponsored
schemes implemented for developing agro-
rural industries in Rajasthan;

303
(b) the details of funds allocated and
spent, during the last three years;
(c) the targets set and the achievements
made in this regard, during the last three
years;
(d) whether at present any  proposals
regarding agro-rural industries, from the
Government of Rajasthan, are pending for
consideration with the Centre; and
(e) if so, the details and status thereof?
Priority list of Infrastructure
Committee
†1337. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRO AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the priority
list of Infrastructure Committee
constituted under the Chairmanship of the
Prime Minister, does not cover important
areas such as, agriculture and rural
industries;
(b) whether it is a fact that Khadi
Gramodyog, a leading agency in the field of
rural employment, has turned defunct due
to Government's apathetic attitude;
